Card Q&A

  • Q6097

    Mar. 13, 2026

    2 copies of this card are in the battle area.
    Can I activate the [Your Turn] effect on both copies of this card and play 1 [ADVENTURE] trait card with the play cost reduced by 2?
    No, you can't.
    You can't activate multiple card-playing effects at the same time.

  • Q6098

    Mar. 13, 2026

    When I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and an [ADVENTURE] trait Digimon card would be played, can I activate ST21-13 [Matt Ishida & T.K. Takaishi]'s [Your Turn] effect and reduce the play cost by a total of 2?
    Yes, you can.
